recap.text: Agatha is with the Meadow Lark party, including Imani and Yolanda Martinez. She wheels a shopping cart behind six fighters into a redoubt, where Carl lifts the cart into his inventory. A flying bolt opens her head, but she makes level four by standing beside the Ball of Swine. After disappearing, she arrives at the stairwell pushing the squeaking cart.

Agatha reappears at the station 36 stairwell on level eight. She is human with no class and pushes a squeaking shopping cart with a pink flamingo at the front. The steps turn into a ramp for her. Carl holds Imani back when she moves to intercept Agatha.

Crawler Li Jun sees a level 12 woman with a shopping cart at the stairwell by his bubble. She speaks to no one and goes down the stairs before the six-hour mark. Carl states that the woman is Agatha and they must ignore her.

Orren tells a crawler that Agatha is a Residual of a different kind. In Wenatchee, Agatha is Agent 22, an old woman in a failing human shell who reads a flash message from Borant. She is not of the Apothecary or Valtay, but she lights a fire in a barrel to bring an entrance near.

A level 23 woman with a shopping cart named Agatha visits Shanty Town looking for Carl. The prime minister of the Syndicate orders Carl not to interact with her. Warlord Agatha of the War Mage Rebellion gains the Conscription spell and a rule that soldiers drop dead when a team is defeated. She takes the Scavenger's Daughter and leaves the floor.

beats.headline: The mysterious Agatha
beats.text: Agatha. She is with the Meadow Lark party when Carl and Donut find them: Imani, Yolanda Martinez, the Andrews brothers, and her. The others I can account for, level by level, box by box, all the way back to the stairs. Agatha I can account for. Mostly. Let's leave it there. The party calls her mysterious, which is the kindest word available and also the most accurate.
beats.gist: Agatha is a mysterious member of the Meadow Lark party with Imani, Yolanda Martinez, and the Andrews brothers.

beats.headline: You are not doing this without her
beats.text: Entry: Crawler Agatha, no party, wheels her shopping cart in behind the six fighters, cackling, and the bars come down behind all seven. She is not in the plan and there is no room for her in the redoubt. Crawler Carl lifts the cart into his inventory, over objections. She is told to sit in the middle, and she screams about the cart for the whole fight. A flying bolt opens her head. She does not appear to notice.
beats.gist: Crawler Agatha wheels her shopping cart behind six fighters before the bars drop.

beats.headline: She is in the room, and then she is not
beats.text: For the record: Agatha was in the room for the Ball of Swine beside Brandon, Chris, Yolanda, Imani, Carl and the cat, and made level four for being there, which is not the same as doing anything. Then she went missing. The next I have of her is her name on a dead grub. She is not on the recap. The party assumes the worst. I nearly always have a forwarding address.
beats.gist: Agatha reaches level four for attending the Ball of Swine, then vanishes and appears on a dead grub.

beats.headline: Them critters already know
beats.text: For the record: Crawler Agatha, level four, still alive, arrives at the stairwell pushing the same squeaking cart. Crawler Carl has just found, in his inventory history, three items that came out of it: an inter-tunnel communications relay, flagged illegal; a platinum personal shield; a pulse pistol. One manufacturer. He offers to fix her wheel. No need, she says. Them critters already know she's here; they just don't know what to do about it. She goes down. The feed was out for a couple of minutes, which is nothing unusual.
beats.gist: Agatha arrives at the stairwell pushing a squeaking cart.

beats.headline: Down the stairs with her cart
beats.text: Subject Agatha reappears at the station 36 stairwell: level eight, still human, still no class, pushing a squeaking shopping cart with the pink flamingo standing at the front. The steps turn into a ramp for her. She cackles that she sees they are all still kicking and goes down. Imani moves to intercept her and Carl holds her back, telling her they will talk about it another time. Imani wants to know what is happening. Nobody answers.
beats.gist: Agatha pushes a squeaking shopping cart with a pink flamingo down a ramp at stairwell 36.

beats.headline: Down before the six-hour mark
beats.text: Sighting, via Crawler Li Jun at the stairwell by his bubble: a woman with a shopping cart pulls up out of nowhere, speaks to no one, and goes down the stairs before the six-hour mark. She is level 12. Li Jun does not know where she came from. Crawler Carl's position on the matter, stated in full: that is Agatha, and we just ignore Agatha.
beats.gist: Li Jun sees a level 12 woman with a shopping cart go down the stairs.

beats.headline: A Residual of a different kind
beats.text: Clarification, supplied by a liaison in a closed office. Asked whether the old woman from Meadow Lark is the same sort of thing as a homeless man in Homestead, Orren says yes. Agatha is also a Residual, though of a different kind. Asked in what way, he says that is not the crawler's concern. Asked whether this means no more Agatha, he says he would not go that far.
beats.gist: Orren tells a crawler that Agatha is a Residual of a different kind.

beats.headline: Agent number 22, in Wenatchee
beats.text: On the night of the collapse, a flash message: Borant is starting the Earth season early. In an alley in Wenatchee, behind Meadowlark Elder Care, an old woman in a failing human shell reads it twice. Agent 22, also known as Agatha. Ten years peeled away from her collective. Not of the Apothecary, though she took a residual's body to read its feed; not Valtay, though biologically similar. Her people want the primal to know who it really is, and she would sweep the universe clean of biological life. She lights a fire in a barrel, to bring an entrance near. Timing is everything.
beats.gist: Agent 22, also known as Agatha, lights a fire in a barrel to bring an entrance near.

beats.headline: Asking for Carl by name
beats.text: A visitor at Shanty Town, reported by Li Jun, who was too busy to follow her up: a crazy old white lady with a shopping cart, level 23, no class, whom the system would not let him recruit. She came looking for Carl. She tried to get into Larracos, and Larracos would not let her in, so she went to the bar where Lucia Mar is still camped. Straight after, Zev passes on an order from the prime minister of the Syndicate himself. Carl is not to interact with Agatha. Nobody tells Zev why.
beats.gist: Li Jun reports a level 23 white lady with a shopping cart looking for Carl.

beats.headline: In the AI's metaphor
beats.text: Nobody is to venture too far from the metaphor. There is a girl who teaches the AI something new every day and whom its family likes, and she once had a huge boyfriend who she says is dead but is actually in prison. Is she using it? Trying to get it to fight him? What does she look like, Donut asks. She looks like Agatha, Orren says, drily. Then there is the older woman from the same hometown, who wants the prisoner dead too, and who has been giving the AI pointers on getting stronger.
beats.gist: Orren tells Donut that the girl in the AI's metaphor looks like Agatha.

beats.headline: Three emergency action items
beats.text: Warlord Agatha of the War Mage Rebellion has proposed three emergency action items. One: full access to the warlord system and the right to claim thrones. Granted, and something they already had. Two: full use of the Conscription spell, reaching unaffiliated players. Granted. Three: in the Peeling Phase, revert to the original Faction Wars rule, under which a defeated team's warlords and soldiers die. Granted, with a caveat: every affiliated soldier and warlord still on the field drops dead the moment the team is defeated. Then the Rebellion occupied Team Retribution's throne room.
beats.gist: Warlord Agatha proposes three emergency action items and the Rebellion occupies Team Retribution's throne room.

beats.headline: What the adjutants think she is
beats.text: Two readings are on file. Rosetta's, privately: the woman with a knack for vanishing and reappearing is not the harmless kind of residual but the rarer kind, closer to the Nebulars who worship the Eulogist, and so an enemy of the Apothecary. Fopsy's, aloud, to Victory: she is trying to end the ascendency game quickly, because with no crawlers left the system shuts down and hibernates, and she may believe the local AI now threatens the Eulogist. He does not know how she enlisted the war mages. Victory doubts they are assisting each other at all.
beats.gist: Rosetta privately views Agatha as a rare residual and an enemy of the Apothecary.

beats.headline: Akuma's warning
beats.text: Warlord Akuma, to the Warlord Chat: the War Mages are leaving the floor, and they have found the Scavenger's Daughter and are taking her with them. Then, to Carl and Donut specifically, a warning. Agatha is an enemy to all of you. His words, not mine. He did not elaborate, and I am the referee here, not the colour commentary, whatever it may look like from where you're standing.
beats.gist: Warlord Akuma warns Carl and Donut that Agatha is an enemy to all of them.

relations.note: Also a Residual, of a different kind
